title: Sick Bacchus by Caravaggio
episode: Episode #47: Shock Art: Caravaggio's Sick Bacchus (Season 5, Episode 1)
description: An early self-portrait by Caravaggio as the god of wine, with a greenish face and gray lips, painted around 1593 when he was poor and possibly ill. It is in the Borghese Gallery.

title: The Stufetta of Cardinal Bibbiena
episode: A Little Curious #3: The Pope's Secret Sexy Bathroom
description: A short episode on the tiny bathroom Raphael’s workshop painted with erotic scenes from mythology for Cardinal Bibbiena in the Vatican palace around 1516. It is rarely shown to the public.
